# Web quality audit (Addy Osmani)

Audits a site for performance, accessibility, SEO and best practices, Lighthouse-style.

- Source: https://github.com/addyosmani/web-quality-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addyosmani/web-quality-skills/main/skills/web-quality-audit/SKILL.md
- Author: Addy Osmani
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/web-quality-audit-addy-osmani-3c5ac52d

Runs an evidence-based review of a web page across performance, accessibility, SEO, best practices and readiness for AI browsing agents. It routes to the right tools, assigns severity levels and returns results in a fixed format with a quick checklist. A helper script is included. Lighthouse or a browser helps but isn't strictly required.

**Try asking:**
- "Audit my site's web quality"
- "Run a Lighthouse-style audit on our homepage"
- "What should I fix first to optimize this website?"
